'''Ellor Orgraal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] around [[55 BBY/Legends|55 BBY]], he was originally a low-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Orgraal managed to rise through the ranks by showing servile deference to whoever was his superior. When the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Orgraal took advantage of the resulting confusion to tamper with the records, exchanging the hierarchical status of a deceased bureaucrat with his own. With his forged service record, he kept kowtowing till he reached a governorship. On his new fiefdom of Ord Radama,<ref name="OAA" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Governor Orgraal started solidifying his personal power by silencing anyone who dared criticize the Empire. According to rumors, the governor even suppressed a number of lesser [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] who had protested his rule.<ref name="OAA" />

==Personality ands traits==
Orgraal was a short man, measuring only 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height. During his time as an Imperial governor, he wore his [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] slicked back and [[Clothing/Legends|dressed]] in finely tailored civilian attires that resembled a classic formal style. A cold, calculating man, Orgraal felt so deep a disdain for his subordinates that he wore a perpetual scowl.<ref name="OAA" />
